Container.Name: stemkit
Container.Overview: StemKit in your browser. Search YouTube or paste a link, pick the instruments you want, and the server splits the song into stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other). Play the result like a mini mixer with the video beside a fader for every stem, or download stems as WAV. Separation runs on an NVIDIA GPU when one is passed through (install the Nvidia Driver plugin, driver 570 or newer), otherwise on the CPU, just slower. Pick an engine per song: Quick (Demucs) or Best (BS-Roformer SW, cleaner, with real guitar and piano stems), plus optional studio vocals, a second pass, a drum kit split into kick, snare, toms, hi-hat, ride and crash, and key and chord detection shown on a timeline. Models download into the data folder the first time they are used (699 MB, 913 MB and 438 MB). The player can also download each video (Settings, or per song) and play it from the server, which keeps the picture in step instead of stuttering while the YouTube embed rebuffers. There is no login unless you set a password below, so keep it on your LAN or behind a reverse proxy.
Container.Requires: For GPU splits install the Nvidia Driver plugin. No GPU? Remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters and it runs on the CPU.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Song library (split stems take about 20 MB per stem per minute of audio), settings, thumbnails and downloaded models. Drop a Netscape format cookies.txt exported from a logged in YouTube browser session here if YouTube starts asking to sign in to confirm you are not a bot.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU to use: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the browser asks for it (HTTP basic auth). Leave empty for no login.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Optional username to go with the password. Empty accepts any username.

Config.Name: Update yt-dlp on start
Config.Description: Installs the newest yt-dlp into the data folder at every container start. YouTube changes often break older versions.

Config.Name: Vocals model attention
Config.Description: GPU attention kernel for the studio vocals model: efficient, flash or math. efficient is the safe default; flash can be slightly faster but has produced garbled output on some newer cards.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns created files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns created files (100 = users).
